summary.zh: 检验销售预测、赢单率与招聘计划
summary.en: Pressure-test a revenue forecast, a win-rate drop, or sales hiring.

description.zh: 在采信营收预测、解释赢单率下滑或批准销售扩编时，检查管道质量、成交周期和人均产能是否支撑这些数字。适合季度预测与销售预算评审。
description.en: Checks whether pipeline quality, deal cycles, and per-rep capacity actually support the forecast, the win-rate story, or the sales hiring plan. Use it during quarterly forecasting and sales budget reviews.
